Native sparse PACE future split conformal prediction

etr_sparse_fpca_partial_conformal_native.Rd

From a fully separated proper-training fit and calibration set, compute the maximum standardized absolute future residual at an exact finite grid of observed future measurements, aggregate curves within a declared participant/group if required, then take the exact conservative order statistic \(\lceil(n+1)(1-\alpha)\rceil\). Apply it to a single disjoint target curve's conditional full-covariance Gaussian prediction. No raw interpolation, latent-function or continuous-domain coverage claim is made. Coverage requires independent exchangeable calibration units. Complete frozen Python 1.2 source-domain parity is not certified.

Usage

etr_calibrate_sparse_fpca_partial_conformal_native(
  fit, calibration, history_cutoff, prediction_grid,
  alpha = 0.05, group_column = NULL,
  min_history_observations = 2L,
  condition_limit = NULL, history_ridge = NULL
)
etr_sparse_fpca_conformal_prediction_band_native(
  calibration, trajectory
)
etr_sparse_fpca_conformal_band_frame_native(result)

Arguments

fit

A native source-model sparse FPCA population fit.

calibration

Independent irregular calibration trajectories, or a fitted calibration object in the second method.

history_cutoff

Finite history endpoint used by each curve's conditional prediction.

prediction_grid

Finite future timestamps exactly observed on each calibration curve.

alpha

Conformal miscoverage level strictly inside (0,1).

group_column

Optional named exchangeability group in both training and calibration metadata. Scalar labels use source-style text. Missing character labels represent None and missing double or factor labels represent nan.

min_history_observations

Positive minimum native history observation count.

condition_limit

Optional upper bound on history-covariance condition number.

history_ridge

Optional nonnegative numerical history covariance ridge.

trajectory

Single target trajectory disjoint from training and calibration units.

result

A native sparse finite-grid conformal band object.

Value

The calibration function returns per-curve scores, per-unit maximum scores, the corresponding curve and unit counts, the exact finite-sample rank and its critical value. The band function returns upper/lower target observed-measurement bands. The frame method provides one row per declared future time.
